prompt_head:
Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) Professional experience building and dep

assessments.note: About 4 years building and shipping AI agent systems, including a LangGraph agent end to end.
Python and TypeScript used in multiple production-style projects.
Covers tracing, context pipelines and tools, but permissions, controls and feedback are not shown.
Built LangGraph agents with tool use and human review in the loop.
LangGraph state-machine agent graphs and human approval workflows are shown.
Lists LLM evals and HITL skills, but no evidence of designing eval systems.
Prompting, RAG, structured outputs and tool use shown; model selection trade-offs are not.
Langfuse tracing used to observe LLM behavior and diagnose issues.
APIs, Postgres, Docker, CI and cloud shown; distributed systems depth is not evidenced.
Onboarded enterprise clients and delivered CRM and integration work with stakeholders.
Strong AI and agent work shown, but no explicit evidence of explaining risks to others.
No evidence of travel for client workshops or on-site delivery.
LangGraph agent framework and Claude Code orchestration are used in projects.
Cloudflare Workers experience only; no AWS, Azure or Google Cloud evidence.
Has Claude Code skill but no Claude Architect certification listed.

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets most core agent and engineering requirements, with gaps in eval design, travel, and named cloud platforms.
top_gaps: Travel for client workshops or on-site delivery
AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud experience
